entry.title: US universities race to launch AI majors as the count passes 100, nearly double in a year
entry.summary:
Iiyunivesithi ezingaphezu kwe-100 zaseMelika ngoku zinikezela ngesidanga sokuqala kwi-AI ngaphakathi kwamasebe ezobunzululwazi benjineli yekhompyutha, okumalunga nokuphindwe kabini kunonyaka owodwa odluleleyo, ngokutsho kwesiseko sedata esigcinwa liziko le-Center for Inclusive Computing kwiYunivesithi yaseNortheastern. Isidanga se-AI seYunivesithi yaseBentley sikhule ukusuka kubafundi abambalwa ekuqaleni kwaso ngo-2024 ukuya kufikelela ekubeni mazi-100 kulo nyaka, ngelixa isidanga seMIT se-AI and Decision Making, esaqalwa ngo-2022, singesidanga sesibini esithandwa kakhulu kwiyunivesithi, nabafundi abangama-354 ababhalisileyo. Abaphathi badibanisa oku kungxama kokungonwabi kwabafundi ngemveliso yemisebenzi eguqulwe yi-AI, kwaye kunyanzelo lwabaqeshi lokufuna abaphumelele izidanga abanobuchule be-AI; uphando lwenziwa ngoMeyi lufumanise ukuba sinye kuphela kwiziko-zezi-66 eziphenduliweyo zinikezela ngesidanga se-AI ezifuna isifundo sokuziphatha.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD ngokubhekiselele kwi-AI, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, ubungakanani kunye nesantya sotshintsho oku emntla weHlabathi, kunye nemfuneko engalinganiyo yoqeqesho lokuziphatha olunamkelwayo nalo, ngomlinganiselo iWits AHEAD enganokuwusebenzisa ukucinga indlela iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika ezinakho ukuyila izidanga ze-AI ezifanayo, ngendlela enembopheleleko kunokuba isabela nje.

WBUR · Public radio news report

entry.title: Study combines AI-TPACK and Freire's critical pedagogy to rethink AI in African STEM curricula
entry.summary:
Abaphandi ababini baseYunivesithi yoMzantsi Afrika (UNISA) babeka uphiko lwengcamango lokufaka i-AI kwikharityhulam ye-STEM kwilizwekazi laseAfrika, badibanisa imodeli ye-AI-TPACK kunye nendlela yokufundisa ebukhali kaPaulo Freire. Bexhomekeke kuphononongo lweencwadi kunokwenza uphando lwezenzo, iphepha liphonononga izixhobo ezifana nemiqulu yokufundisa ekrelekrele, iiplatform zokufunda eziguquguqukayo, kunye noviwo olwenziwa ngomatshini, lixele ukuba izinto ezi zinganceda ukunciphisa uxinzelelo kwiklasi ezigcwele kwaye ezinqabileyo kwizixhobo. Liphakamisa amacebo ahambelana nenkcubeko kwaye asekwe kumgaqo-nkqubo wokuziphatha, ajongana nendlala yeziseko zophuhliso, isakhono sootitshala kunye nokwahlukana kweemeko, ukwenzela ukuba ukwamkelwa kwe-AI akungxwelerhi ukungalingani okukhoyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi weWits AHEAD ngokubhekiselele kwi-AI kunye nohlalutyo lwedata kwi-STEM nemfundo yootitshala, iphepha eli lithi linike uphiko oluphicothayo, olusekelwe eAfrika, lokuvavanya izithembiso ze-AI kufundiso ye-STEM ngokumelene nokungenelela kwenyani kwilizwekazi ngokubhekiselele kwiziseko zophuhliso kunye nesakhono sootitshala, isilumkiso esifanele sithintele ukungxamiseka kokwamkelwa kwe-AI.

Eurasia Journal of Mathematics, Science and Technology Education (University of South Africa) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Survey finds most Built Environment students use AI chatbots but African universities still lack formal AI policy
entry.summary:
Uphando lwabafundi be-Built Environment, olwaziswayo kwiNdibano ye-FIG ka-2026 eKapa, lufumanise ukuba ipesenti ezingama-74 zisebenzisa izinkulumbukhulu ze-AI ngenxa yemfundo, kwaye zineembono eziphuhlileyo ngazo, kodwa zithi zifumana ukhokelo oluncinane lweziko. Ababhali, ababhala besuka eNamibia naseNigeria, baphawula ukuba izikolo nje ezimbalwa zoMzantsi Afrika, kubandakanywa iWits, iYunivesithi yeKapa, iYunivesithi yePitoli neYunivesithi yaseJohannesburg, ziye zenze imigaqo ye-AI ukususela ngo-2024, ngelixa iipesenti ezingama-70 kwiiyunivesithi zeMelika zinemigaqo-nkqubo ye-AI ebhaliweyo. Zibeka icebo lohambo lokokuba iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika zakhe ulawulo lwe-AI olufanelekileyo kwimeko yazo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika yeWits AHEAD yokuba i-AI ibe nembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, ukufunyaniswa kokuba amaziko amaninzi aseAfrika awanamigaqo ye-AI esebenzayo, nangona abafundi basebenzisa izinkulumbukhulu ze-AI ngobuninzi, kubonisa ukuba ulawulo lusemva kakhulu kunokwenzeka; icebo lohambo elikweliphepha linika indawo yokuqala yokuvala lo msantsa.

FIG Congress 2026 (International Federation of Surveyors), Cape Town · Conference paper (International Federation of Surveyors)

entry.title: WISE and Education Collaborative partner with five African universities on an AI adoption pilot
entry.summary:
I-WISE (i-World Innovation Summit for Education) kunye ne-Education Collaborative yase-Ashesi University baqalise iprojekthi yovavanyo lokusetyenziswa kwe-AI kunye neeyunivesithi ezintlanu zaseAfrika: i-Bells University of Technology eNigeria, i-Botho University eBotswana, i-KCA University eKenya, i-University of Kigali eRwanda, kunye neUniversité d'Abomey-Calavi eBenin. Ukusukela ngo-Okthobha 2026 ukuya kuJuni 2027, iyunivesithi nganye iza kuvavanya iprojekthi efanelekileyo ngokweemfuno zayo, kususela koonontlalontle be-AI ehambelana nekharityhulumu kunye nezixhobo zokufunda ezizinzileyo, ukuya kwiinkqubo zesilumkiso kwangethuba kunye nezikhokelo zolawulo lwemibutho. Luvavanyo luxhomekeke kuphononongo lwesiseko lwango-2025 olwenziwa kuma-47 eeyunivesithi zaseAfrika, olwafumanisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI akuzinzile kananjalo ulawulo lusesezantsi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi ka-Wits AHEAD ngolawulo olunembeko lwe-AI, luvavanyo olunqabileyo lwamazwe amaninzi oluvavanya izixhobo ze-AI kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo wemibutho ngaxeshanye kwiiyunivesithi ezintlanu zaseAfrika ezahluke ngokupheleleyo, lunika ubungqina bokuqala bothelekiso ngendlela ukusetyenziswa olunembeko olubonakala ngayo ngokwenyani.

africa.com (WISE and The Education Collaborative, Ashesi University) · International education initiative announcement

entry.title: Early success indicators at a South African university: a data-centric approach to student success
entry.summary:
UPhilokuhle Majozi noKgadi Mathabathe base-University of Pretoria baphakamise uhlaka "lwezibonakaliso zempumelelo yokuqala" oludibanisa iindawo zedatha kunye namanyathelo enkxaso ngesigaba sonke sobomi bomfundi, kususela ngaphambi kobhaliso ukusa kuvavanyo lwekamva. Ngokuxhomekeke kudliwanondlebe nabaqeqeshi bempumelelo yemfundo, iinkokeli zeziko kunye nazobunzululwazi bedatha, uhlaka olu lukhetha indlela esekelwe emandleni, enamandla wokuqalisa ngokuzenzekelayo, kunokuba kube ngamanqaku okulumkisa kwangethuba agxile kubuthathaka athetha ngokuba abafundi "basemngciphekweni."

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kunika intsika yoWits AHEAD yohlalutyo oluqikelelayo ikhetho lasemzantsi Afrika, elisekelwe emandleni, esikhundleni sezinto zemveliso zokulumkisa kwangethuba eziqhelekileyo, nto leyo ebalulekileyo kakhulu ekuyileni amanyathelo okugcina abafundi asekelayo kunokuba aphawule nje abafundi abajongene nobunzima.

Journal of Student Affairs in Africa · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Cambridge-led OpRaise report: AI markers favour style over substance in university essays
entry.summary:
Abaphandi bevela kwiiYunivesithi zeCambridge, Manchester Metropolitan neNottingham baphonononga iimodeli ezintathu eziphambili ze-AI, ngazinye kwaye zidibene, kwizincoko 761 zesaikholoji zabafundi bomnyaka wokuqala ezivela kwiiyunivesithi ezintathu zeUK. Iimodeli ezi zazivumelana ngokupheleleyo phakathi kwazo, kodwa zivumelana kancinci kakhulu nabavavanyi abangabantu, zihlala zinika amanqaku aphezulu kubhalo olude kwaye olunzulu, kungakhathaliseki ukufaneleka kwemfundo, kwaye amanqaku ebuthelelana embindini wesikali.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Ngoxa i-Wits AHEAD icinga indima ye-AI kuvavanyo, lo phando oluqinileyo oluvela kwiziko ngeziko lubonisa ukuba uphawulo oluzenzekelayo lusenika amandla indlela yokubhala kunokuqulathwe, oku kungumlumkiso ngokuchasene nokubeka i-AI esikhundleni sokugweba komntu kwiiyunivesithi zoMzantsi weHlabathi, apho amaklasi makhulu ngakumbi kwaye abavavanyi bambalwa.

University of Cambridge, Manchester Metropolitan University and the University of Nottingham (OpRaise project) · University research report

entry.title: World Bank video: Korea Partnership Facility forum explores AI for education and skills
entry.summary:
Ikhanali yeYouTube yeWorld Bank Group ipapashe ividiyo emfutshane malunga nenkomfa yalo nyaka ye-Korea-World Bank Group Partnership Facility, apho amagosa evela kwisebe lezoqoqosho namaxhoba zemali yaseKorea, iingcali zeWorld Bank kunye nonjingalwazi we-KAIST baxubushe indlela i-AI enganokomeleza ngayo ukufunda kwaye ilungiselele abantu imisebenzi yexesha elizayo. I-Facility ixhasa iinkqubo ze-AI nezakhono zedijithali kwiinkqubo zemfundo nemisebenzi kumazwe asakhasayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwi-Pillar 4, oku kubonisa ukuba amaziko emali ehlabathi ngoku ajonga uqeqesho lwezakhono ze-AI njengokubalulekileyo kuqesheko lwabaphumelele izidanga kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, kungekhona okongezelelweyo.

World Bank Group (YouTube) · International financial institution, official video channel

entry.title: Study finds South African universities' AI policies strong on student rules, thin on privacy and staff duties
entry.summary:
Uphononongo oluphononongayo iimigaqo ye-AI evelisayo epapashwe ziiyunivesithi karhulumente zoMzantsi Afrika lufumanise ukuba ama-46% kuphela eeziko afumana umgaqo-nkqubo wesiko liphela ngexesha lohlalutyo. Apho iimigaqo zazikhona, zazibeka imigaqo echazwe kakuhle malunga nokucacileko kunye noxanduva lwabafundi, kodwa zaphatha ubuyele, ulawulo lwedatha kunye noxanduva lwabasebenzi kafutshane, ikakhulu njengecebiso kungekhona imigaqo enyanzelekileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwi-Pillar 6, lobu bungqina obuthe ngqo kwi-Wits AHEAD: ababhali bafuna imigaqo evunyelweyo, eyilwe kwasekuqaleni ukukhusela ubuyele, oko kona kukhona isikroba solawulo lwe-AI olunoxanduva eli qela eliluhlalutya.

Universal Access in the Information Society · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Smartphone AI tools help STEM teachers in low-resource African classrooms move beyond chalk and talk, study finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwemeko oluphathwe yi-Universiti Sains Malaysia lusebenzisane noothisha be-STEM abalishumi baseNigeria, Botswana, Ghana, Namibia naseSierra Leone kwindlu yomsebenzi yesandla esisebenzisa iintonga ze-AI eziguqula izwi libe ngumfanekiso, ukubhala ikhowudi ngeeblokhi kwifowuni, kunye nokulingiswa kweesekethe zombane. Ootitshala bathi izixhobo ezi zenze kube lula ukubonisa izinto zenzululwazi ezinzima ukucacisa, zavumela abafundi abangenazo iikhompyutha eziphathwayo ukwakha izakhono zokubhala ikhowudi kwifowuni, zaza zabavumela ukuvavanya iisekethe ngokukhuselekileyo ngaphambi kokuchukumisa izixhobo zenyani ezinqabileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwi-Pillar 3, lobu bungqina obuhle bokuba izixhobo ze-AI ezikhethwe ngononophelo kwaye zingabizi, kungekhona izixhobo ezibiza kakhulu, ziyazo ezinganokutshintsha ukufundiswa kwe-STEM kwiindlu zefundo zaseAfrika ezinqabileyo ngezixhobo ukusuka kufundiso yelekicha ukuya kuphononongo lwenyani.

ECNU Review of Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI and data, not just adopt it, UFS tells QS Africa Forum
entry.summary:
Kwindibano ye-QS Africa Forum 2026 eyenzeke e-Addis Ababa, uNjingalwazi Sam Tshehla, iSekela loMlawuli omkhulu kwi-University of the Free State (UFS), uthethe kwindibano ngomfuneko we-AI nekamva lemfundo ephakamileyo esithi iiyunivesithi zase-Afrika kufuneka ziyeke ukuphendula kuphela kwi-AI, bakhele idatha neenkqubo zabo ezibonisa iilwimi, iinkcubeko kunye noluphuhliso lwelizwekazi. Uthe i-AI inganceda kuhambo lomfundi lonke, ukusuka ekwamkelweni ukuya kufundisa noluphando, kodwa kuphela ngotyalomali kufundo lwedijithali, ulawulo nemigaqo yokuziphatha.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 6 ngokuphathelele i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, lesi sibizo sedata kunye neenkqubo ezizezaseAfrika zihambelana nokugxininisa kwe-Wits AHEAD ekubeni indlela zolawulo lwe-AI zisekelwe kwilizwe ngalinye kunokungeniswa ngaphandle, kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

University of the Free State · University report

entry.title: AI exposure linked to 13 percentage point rise in top grades, Berkeley working paper finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha lophando elenziwe ngu-Igor Chirikov we-Center for Studies in Higher Education kwi-University of California, Berkeley, lihlalutya amanqaku angaphezu kwe-500,000 awanikwa phakathi kweminyaka ka-2018 no-2025 kwiyunivesithi enkulu yophando. Kwizifundo ezinemisebenzi emininzi yokubhala nekhowudi, inxenye yamanqaku aphezulu yanyuka ngama-ponto wepesenti ali-13 emva kokukhutshwa kwe-ChatGPT, malunga nama-30 epesenti ngaphezulu kokwenziwa ngo-2022, unyuko olona lukhulu lwenzeka apho umsebenzi wasekhaya ubalwa kakhulu kwinqaku lokugqibela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 1 ngokusebenzisa i-AI evelisayo kufundiso, uvavanyo nengqibelelo, olu phando lusilumkiso ngokuba amanqaku aphezulu akuthethi ngoku ukufunda okungcono: umsebenzi we-Wits AHEAD wokuguqula uvavanyo kufuneka uqwalasele lo mngcipheko kwimisebenzi yasekhaya.

Center for Studies in Higher Education, UC Berkeley · Working paper, University of California, Berkeley (CSHE)

entry.title: Generative AI closes three-quarters of the productivity gap between more and less educated workers, NBER study finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha lophando le-National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), elibhalwe ngu-Guillermo Cruces, Diego Fernández Meijide, Sebastian Galiani, Ramiro H. Gálvez no-María Lombardi, lixela ngovavanyo olwenziwe ngokungahleliwe kubantu abadala abangama-1,174 abenza umsebenzi wokusombulula ingxaki yeshishini. Ngaphandle kwe-AI evelisayo, abathathi-nxaxheba abane-mfundo ephakamileyo babesenza ngcono kunabo bane-mfundo ephantsi ngama-standard deviation angama-0.548; ngoncedo lwe-AI, lo msantsa wehla ukuya kuma-0.139 standard deviation, ivala phantse isithathu kwesine somsantsa wokuqala. Inzuzo le yagcina kuphela inxalenye yayo ngoxa isixhobo se-AI sisuswa kumsebenzi olandelayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 4 ye-Wits AHEAD ngesakhono sabafundi abaphumelele, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, oku kufunyenweyo kunamacala amabini: i-AI evelisayo inganciphisa umsantsa wexesha elide wokusebenza, kodwa le nzuzo iphela ukuba akukho umzamo oqhubekayo, ngoko iikharityhulam kusafuneka zakhe isakhono esisisiseko esi i-AI incede kuphela.

National Bureau of Economic Research · Working paper, National Bureau of Economic Research

entry.title: World Bank warns AI's benefits in Africa could bypass the poorest households
entry.summary:
Ingxelo yeWorld Bank, i-Africa Economic Update yenyanga ka-October 2026, ebizwa ngokuba yi-'Building AI Readiness', iqikelela ukuba ukukhula koqoqosho e-Sub-Saharan Africa kuya kunyuka kusuka kwi-4.1 ekhulu ngo-2025 ukuya kwi-4.3 ekhulu ngo-2026, oku kuncedwa ngokuyinxenye kukunyuka okukhawulezileyo komsebenzi wababumbi bezixhobo zekhompyuter: iqela lababumbi bezixhobo zekhompyuter laseNigeria kwi-GitHub likhule ngokuphindaphindeka kalishumi ukususela ngo-2020, elaseGhana lakhula phantse kaphindwe sibhozo. Ingxelo ithi i-AI inganyusa imveliso kwaye idale amathuba emisebenzi kulo lonke lo mmandla, kodwa ithi ukusetyenziswa kwayo akukalingani kwaye kugxile kumazwe ambalwa, ingakumbi iKenya, iNigeria kunye noMzantsi Afrika. Icaphula umbane othembekileyo, uxhumano lwe-intanethi olungabizi kakhulu, ubuchule bedijithali kunye nokukwazi korhulumente njengeemfuneko ezisasilele kwimimandla emininzi yalo mmandla.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 6 ye-Wits AHEAD ngokusebenzisa i-AI enoxanduva, ukulingana kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, le ngxelo isilumkiso esicacileyo: iinkqubo zemfundo ephakamileyo kuMzantsi weHlabathi azinakucinga ukuba iingenelo ze-AI ziya kufika ngaziqu zazo; ukwakha amandla edijithali nawamaziko abalulekileyo kusenokuba yimfuneko yangaphambili.

World Bank · Intergovernmental regional economic report

entry.title: Critical review finds Ghana's national AI strategy strong on readiness but thin on classroom detail
entry.summary:
Uhlalutyo olubuzisayo lwemigaqo-nkqubo, olwenziwe ngu-Matthew Nyaaba kunye noosisibhali-ndawonye abalithoba, lwenza iSakhelo soMgaqo-nkqubo we-AI esigxile kwimfundo, lwaze lwasisebenzisa kwiSicwangciso seSizwe se-Ghana sobuKrelekrele Bokwenziwa seminyaka ye-2025 ukuya ku-2035. Uphononongo lufumanisa ukuba isicwangciso sinombono omhle ekufundiseni ngobuchule be-AI, isakhono lolutsha kunye nokulungiselela umsebenzi, kodwa asikaphuhli ngokwaneleyo ekuzimeleni kootitshala, uqeqesho lootitshala ngaphambi komsebenzi, isikhokelo sekharityhulam novavanyo, ukufundisa okusebenzisa iilwimi ezahlukeneyo nokuhambelana namasiko, kunye nolawulo olubandakanya uluntu kwinqanaba lesikolo. Ababhali bathi i-Ghana ifuna icebo lokuphunyezwa elijolise kwimfundo, elidibanisa iinjongo zomsebenzi noqeqesho lootitshala, utshintsho lwekharityhulam kunye nokhuselo lwabafundi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 6 ye-Wits AHEAD ngokusebenzisa i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ukulingana kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, olu phononongo lusikhumbuzo oluluncedo lokuba izicwangciso zesizwe ze-AI kuMzantsi weHlabathi zihlala zikhokelela ngaphambili kunomsebenzi onqanaba lesikolo ofunekayo ukuzenza zibe yinyani kootitshala nabafundi.

arXiv preprint · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: US study finds no AI-driven unemployment spike yet for recent graduates
entry.summary:
Iphepha lophando elitsha le-National Bureau of Economic Research yase-United States, elibhalwe ngu-Robert Fairlie no-Jane Wu, liphonononge iidatha zemisebenzi e-United States phakathi kweJuni ne-Agasti 2026, ukujonga ukuba i-AI evelisayo iyaqala na ukunyusa intswela-ngqesho kubafundi ababugqibile ubugqirha kutsha nje. Ngokuthelekisa aba bafundi nabo bagqibileyo kudala kunye nolutsha olungafundelanga eyunivesiti, abaphandi abafumananga nyuso enamandla kwintswela-ngqesho enxulumene ne-AI ngehlobo lo-2026, nangona umlinganiselo obanzi obafaka abo bancamileyo ukufuna umsebenzi wongeza malunga neepesenti ezimbini kwizinga lentswela-ngqesho yabafundi abagqibileyo kutsha nje.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 4 ye-Wits AHEAD ngesakhono sabafundi abagqibileyo, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, oku kuphononongo lwangoku, olusekelwe kwiidatha, lokoyika ukuba i-AI evelisayo sele itshabalalisa imisebenzi yabafundi abagqibileyo, isikhumbuzo sokuvavanya izicamango zasekuhlaleni ngobungqina kunokuba ngeendaba eziphambili.

National Bureau of Economic Research · Economic research working paper

entry.title: Fort Hare study proposes Big Data framework to improve student retention in South Africa
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olutsha kwi-South African Journal of Information Management, oluveliswe ngu-Ganizani Mainoti kunye no-Roxanne Piderit base-Dyunivesithi yaseFort Hare, luthethe nabasebenzi abafundisi abamashumi amathathu kuyunivesithi zoluntu ezine zoMzantsi Afrika, kananjalo luphengulule iingxelo kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo yokugcina abafundi. Lufumene oovimba-lwazi beedatha abahlukahlukene kunye nolwazi oluncinane lwedatha phakathi kwabasebenzi, kananjalo lucebisa uqobo lwe-Big Data olusekelwe kulawulo lwedatha ngokunyanisekileyo, inkqubo yedatha edityanisiweyo, uhlalutyo oluqikelelayo kunye noncedo lobuqu, ukususa iiyunivesithi ekuphenduleni ukuyeka izifundo ukuya kukuthintela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 2 ye-Wits AHEAD ngokuphathelele i-AI kunye noHlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi, ukugcinwa kwabo kunye nesilumkiso kwangethuba, olu luphononongo lwasekhaya, oluhlolwe ziingcali, lokuba yintoni efunwa yiinkqubo zedatha edityanisiweyo kunye nolawulo ukuze olu hlobo lohlalutyo lusebenze.

University of Fort Hare, published in the South African Journal of Information Management · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: World Bank's 2026 World Development Report: AI needs reliable power, internet and skills to help developing countries
entry.summary:
Ingxelo ye-World Bank ye-World Development Report ka-2026, ethi 'Isithembiso soBukrelekrele Bokwenziwa', ibeka icebo lokwamkela, ukuziqhelanisa kunye nokuqhubela phambili kubantu abazizigidi ezi-5.6 abahlala kumazwe anamaxabiso aphantsi nawaphakathi. Icebisa ukuba amazwe asakhasayo awafuni kwakha iimodeli ezinkulu ze-AI zawo, kodwa ukuthenga amaxesha nje izixhobo ze-AI akusiyonceda konke konke: i-AI isebenza kakuhle apho izixhobo zomgaqo-sisekelo, kuquka umbane kunye noqhagamshelwano, kunye neenkqubo zemfundo, ngoku bezisebenza kakuhle, ngoxa i-'AI encinci' esiwa nge-SMS okanye ifowuni elulileyo inokufikelela abantu apho ezi nto zisilela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 6 ye-Wits AHEAD ngokuphathelele i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, isilumkiso sengxelo sokuba inzuzo ye-AI ixhomekeke kwizixhobo zomgaqo-sisekelo kunye neenkqubo zemfundo ezisebenza kakuhle, kungekhona ukufikelela kwinzame nje, sichaphazela ngokuthe ngqo iimeko ezisafuneka zakhiwe ziiyunivesithi kunye noorhulumente kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

World Bank · Intergovernmental flagship report

entry.title: UCT video: Cape Town summit brings the global debate on AI and universities to Africa
entry.summary:
Kwividiyo ekhutshwe ngaphambi kwengqungquthela yehlabathi yemfundo ephakamileyo ye-Times Higher Education, iYunivesithi yaseKapa ibhengeze ukuba lo mhlangano, obanjwe ngentsebenziswano neYunivesithi yaseBristol ukusuka ngomhla wamashumi amabini anethoba kuSeptemba ukuya kumhla woku-1 kuOktobha wezi-2026, uya kuba owokuqala ukubanjwa kweli lizwekazi, udibanisa iinkokeli zeeyunivesithi kunye nabenzi mgaqo-nkqubo ukuxoxa nge-AI, ikamva lomsebenzi, ukungalingani kunye nenjongo yeeyunivesithi. Umphathiswa weyunivesithi, Njingalwazi Mosa Moshabela, uthe ingqungquthela ethuba lweeyunivesithi zaseAfrika ukunceda ukubumba uhlahlo-lwalathiso lwehlabathi, nto leyo ebonisa umbono wakhe wokuba iUCT iphuhlise ukufundisa, uphando kunye nefuthe eluntwini ngelixa iqinisa ukuvelisa izinto ezintsha kunye noshishino e-Afrika, okusekelwe kubuntu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Intsika 4 ka-Wits AHEAD malunga nesakhono sabafundi abaphumeleleyo, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, lo ngukhumbuzo lokuba iiyunivesithi zaseAfrika ngoku ziyanceda ukumisela, ingekhona nje ukulandela, uhlahlo-lwalathiso lwehlabathi malunga nendlela imfundo ephakamileyo ekufuneka isabele ngayo kwiimpembelelo ze-AI emsebenzini nakwithuba.

University of Cape Town (YouTube) · University video

entry.title: UNESCO working paper maps AI use across 200 Latin American and Caribbean universities

category.term: 19 countries, Latin America and the Caribbean

entry.summary:
Iphepha losebenzi olutsha le-UNESCO International Institute for Higher Education eLatin America naseCaribbean (IESALC), elenziwe nelye-United Nations University Institute for the Advanced Study of Sustainability, libonisa indlela i-AI esetyenziswa ngayo kwiiyunivesithi ezili-200 kumazwe ali-19 aseLatin America naseCaribbean, aphononongwe phakathi kweyeThupha noyeDisemba (Agasti ukuya kuOktobha) wezi-2025. Likhangela iinxalenye ezintlanu, ukufundisa nokufunda, uphando, unxulumano noluntu, ulawulo kunye nokongamela, ukubonisa apho i-AI isetyenziswa khona kakade, indlela elawulwa ngayo, amandla eziko akhoyo kunye nemigidingo eseleyo. Ababhali banqwenela ukuba iziphumo zisize abaphathi bamaziko kunye nabenzi mgaqo-nkqubo abezwe ukudibanisa i-AI ngendlela enembopheleleko, enobulungisa kwaye ibandakanya wonke umntu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Intsika 5 ka-Wits AHEAD malunga nohlalutyo kunye nedatha yeenkqubo zemfundo kunye nokuthatha izigqibo, oku kunika ubungqina obunqabileyo bommandla wonke malunga nendlela iiyunivesithi ezilawula nezixhase ngayo ukwamkelwa kwe-AI, ngumongo wokuthelekisa kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo yamaziko kaMzantsi Afrika.

UNESCO International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (IESALC), with UNU-IAS · Intergovernmental working paper

entry.title: MIT's own AI committee calls generative AI 'not an optional exercise' for teaching
entry.summary:
Ikomiti ekhethekileyo ye-MIT ephathelele ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI kufundiso, ukufunda nokuqeqeshwa kophando, enikwe lo msebenzi ngabaphathi beziko ngoJanuwari wezi-2026, ipapashe ingxelo yayo yokugqibela ngomhla wamashumi amabini ananzinhlanu kuAgasti wezi-2026, ichaza i-AI evelisayo njengamandla 'anamathuba amangalisayo kunye nemingcipheko ekhathazayo' angekhe aqwalaselwe ngamayunivesithi njengento yokuzikhethela yomgaqo-nkqubo. Endaweni yomthetho omnye, ikomiti icebisa ukuba icandelo ngalinye kunye nootitshala babeke umgaqo-nkqubo wabo ocacileyo ngexesha abafundi bafanele, banokuvumeleka okanye bangavumelekile ukusebenzisa i-AI, baphinde bayile ngokutsha uvavanyo kunye neenjongo zokufunda ngenxa yoko, kwaye baqhubeke bephonononga indlela yabo njengoko itekhnoloji itshintsha. Umongameli Sally Kornbluth uthe ingxelo le ingumzuzu wembalulo ebalaseleyo, kungekhona kuphela kwi-MIT kodwa kwimfundo ephakamileyo jikelele.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Intsika 1 ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, indlela iyunivesithi ephambili yophando ifikelela kwesi sigqibo ngekomiti yayo iqinisekisa isizathu sokuba iWits kunye nabalingane bayo baphathe umgaqo-nkqubo we-AI enqanabeni lezifundo kunye nokuyila kwakhona uvavanyo ngokuphangalela, kungekhona ngokuzikhethela.

entry.title: New dashboard design principles aim to stop learning-analytics tools overstating what they can tell teachers
entry.summary:
Abaphandi babonisa i-TopoLA, ibhodi yokubonisa esebenzisa indlela yohlalutyo lwedatha yetopoloji ebizwa i-zigzag persistent homology kwidatha yeenkqubo zolawulo lokufunda, ukulandelela indlela umsebenzi wokufunda kweklasi otshintsha ngayo ngexesha. Ngenxa yokuba le ndlela yohlalutyo ayikabi nemigaqo esekiweyo yokutolika, ababhali bamisela imigaqo mithathu yoyilo kwibhodi enjalo: ukwahlula umlinganiso ongcolileyo kuphuma kutolikwa kwawo, ukubonakalisa iziphumo ngamanqanaba kunokuzibonakalisa zonke ngaxeshanye, kunye nokuchaza ngokuvakeleyo ukungaqiniseki kwendlela kunokubonisa ukuchaneka okungenyanisekileyo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Intsika 2 ka-Wits AHEAD malunga nohlalutyo oluqikelelayo nohlalutyo lokufunda ngenxa yempumelelo yabafundi, lo ngukhumbuzo lokuba ibhodi ebonakala ichaneka akuthethi ukuba ithembekile, umahluko obalulekileyo kwindlela izixhobo zesilumkiso kwangethuba nokugcina abafundi zisenziwa nokuchazelwa oogqirha abaxhomekeke kuzo.

entry.title: Study finds six AI chatbots give African computing students patchy, often Western-centric career advice

category.term: Ten African countries (study); United States (authors, Florida International University)

entry.summary:
Abaphandi baseFlorida International University baphonononga iimodeli ezinkulu zolwimi ezintandathu, ChatGPT-4, DeepSeek, Gemini, Claude 3.5, Llama 3 kunye ne-Mistral AI, ngendlela abachaza ngayo imisebenzi yekhompyutha yamaqalo kumazwe alishumi ase-Afrika, bahlalutya iimpendulo ezingama-60 ngokumelene no-Computing Curricula 2020. Ii-chatbot bezigubungela ngokungaguqukiyo izakhono zobugcisa ezifana ne-cloud computing kunye nokubhala iinkqubo, kodwa zafumana ipesenti engama-35.4 kuphela ngokubonakalisa izinto zommandla ezifana nezinto zobugcisa, iilwimi, kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo yesizwe; iimodeli ezivulekileyo iLlama (4.47 kweshumi elinesihlanu, 5) kunye neDeepSeek (4.25) zenza ngcono kunokhuba iimodeli ezizezabucala iChatGPT-4 (3.90) kunye neClaude (3.46), ngelixa imodeli evulekileyo i-Mistral AI ifumana u-0.00 ku-4.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Intsika 4 ka-Wits AHEAD malunga nobuchule babafundi abaphumelele kunye nokuqesheka, lo bungqina ngqo bokuba icebiso lomsebenzi oluphuma kwi-AI, oluya lufunwa ngakumbi ngabafundi base-Afrika, lunokuphatha izicamango ezigxile eNtshona ngengqalasizinda nemarike yemisebenzi, nto ababhali abathi ifuna iindlela eziqonda ummandla ngakumbi, ezisekwe kubuntu, kananjalo zixhaswa ngabantu kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

entry.title: Survey of 443 computing students finds the impostor phenomenon, not confidence, shapes how harshly they judge AI use as cheating
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olwenziwe kubafundi ababalelwa kwi-443 abafunda izifundo zekhompyutha kwinqanaba lokuqala nelesiphakathi kwiyunivesithi yase-United States, lwacela ukuba balinganise ubunzima bezehlo ezili-13 zobuqhophololo bezemfundo, kunye nokulinganisa ukuzithemba kanye nokuziva ungafanelekile kwimpumelelo yakho. Abafundi ababe nesi simo ngamandla amakhulu bebedla ngokulinganisa isehlo esinxulumene ne-i-AI njengobuqhophololo obunzulu, logama ukuzithemba kunye nesi simo ngokwaso bebenoxhumano olubi omelene.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Lobu bungqina obuluncedo kumsebenzi we-Intsika 1 ka-Wits AHEAD ngee-AI eveliswayo kunye nengqibelelo yovavanyo: ukuba umfundi uyigweba njani ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI ngokungqongqo kungathetha ngokuzithemba kwakhe kunye nokuziva engowalapha, kungekhona isenzo ngokwaso kuphela, nto ebalulekileyo ekubeni iingxoxo kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo yengqibelelo yezemfundo zenziwa njani.

entry.title: Study of 30,000 student programming submissions finds AI-code matches rising over time, but says that alone cannot prove cheating
entry.summary:
Uphononongo oluphonononge imisebenzi engama-29,970 yabafundi kwimisebenzi yokuziqhelanisa yePython yowama-2021, u-2023 nowama-2025, luyithelekisa kuzisombululo ezingama-90,000 ezenziwe ziinkqubo zolwimi ezikhulu ezintathu ze-AI, lufumanise ukuba ikhowudi yabafundi iye ifana ngakumbi nezisombululo ze-AI ngokuhamba kwexesha, kubandakanya nemisebenzi ephumelele kuzo zonke iimvavanyo ezifihliweyo. Kwimisebenzi emiselwe kabanzi, iinkqubo zazidibana kuphela kwizakhiwo zekhowudi ezimbalwa ezichanekileyo, ngelixa imisebenzi evulelekileyo iye ihlala ihlukahlukene, kuyo kokubini ikhowudi yabafundi ne-AI. Ababhali bagqiba ngokuthi ukufana olunjalo kuluncedo ekulandeleleni utshintsho kwiklasi liphela, kodwa akukwazi kuphela ukungqina ukuba umfundi othile osele usebenzise i-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 1 ye-Wits AHEAD ngokuphathelele i-AI evelisayo, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo yezemfundo, oku kukulumkisa ekuchaseni ukusetyenziswa kokufana kwekhowudi njengobungqina bokona komfundi ngamnye, kananjalo kubonisa imfuneko yokuphinda kuyilwe imisebenzi yovavanyo kunye nokwakha uvimba wezisombululo zesalathiso, kunokuxhomekeka kuphela kufumaniseko.

entry.title: Wits and UJ researchers show early-warning systems for disengaged students are often tested unfairly
entry.summary:
Abaphandi baseYunivesithi yaseWitwatersrand neYunivesithi yaseJohannesburg, kuphepha-ndaba lokuqala olungekahlolwa ngabahlobo bezifundo, babonisa ukuba iinkqubo zesilumkiso sangaphambili zabafundi abayekayo ukubandakanyeka zihlolwa ngolwazi ebelingayi kubakho ngempela ngexesha kwenziwa uqikelelo, nto leyo eyenza iinkqubo zibonakale zingcono kunoko beziya kuba kuko ekusetyenzisweni kokwenyani. Ngokuvavanya iindlela ezintathu zoqikelelo kwiiqikelelo ezingama-49 329 zeveki ngeveki zexesha langempela ezisuka kwiirekhodi zeMoodle, bafumanisa ukuba akukho ndlela inye eyoyisa kuyo yonke imilinganiselo, kwaye ukuthoba umgangatho wesilumkiso kufumana abafundi abaninzi abasemngciphekweni kodwa kunyusa amaxilongo obuxoki ekufuneka abasebenzi balandele.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kubalulekile kumsebenzi weNtsika 2 kaWits AHEAD ngohlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi kuba kunika iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi Afrika indlela enyanisekileyo yokugqiba, phambi kokuxhomekeka kuyo, enoba inkqubo yesilumkiso sangaphambili iya kunceda ngokwenene ukufumana ngexesha abafundi abayekayo ukubandakanyeka, kungekhona nje ukuba ibonakala njani emva kwexesha.

entry.title: Generative AI access does not mean equal use, study of Chinese, Japanese and Mongolian students finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo oluthelekisa abafundi abangu-42 abaseyunivesithi, omnye kwiyunivesithi nganye eChina, eJapan naseMongolia, lufumanise ukuba ukufikelela kwi-AI evelisayo kuphela akuthethi ukuba iya kuba luncedo ngokulinganayo ekufundeni. Abaphandi baseYunivesithi yaseOsaka, iYunivesithi yaseMinnesota, iYunivesithi yaseWaseda kunye neYunivesithi yaseKyoto bachaza ukuba abafundi baseChina babetshintshela phakathi kweenkqubo ze-AI zasekhaya nezehlabathi, abafundi baseJapan basebenzisa ngakumbi izixhobo zehlabathi ngolwimi lwesiJapan, logama abafundi baseMongolia bebesoloko betshintshela kwisiNgesi xa iimpendulo zolwimi lwesiMongolia zibonakala zibuthathaka; onke amaqela amathathu avavanya ukuchaneka, imfihlo, ukuxhomekeka kunye nefuthe kwingqiqo yabo encamisayo phambi kokuba bathembele kwimpendulo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kuyisilumkiso kumsebenzi weNtsika 1 kaWits AHEAD ngendlela i-AI evelisayo ekwimfundo ephakamileyo: ulwimi neemeko zobugcisa zendawo, kungekhona nje ukufikelela, kuko oku kugqibayo ukuba ingaba i-AI evelisayo inceda ngokwenene abafundi ukuba bafunde, isifundo esisebenza ngqo kwiinkqubo zeeyunivesithi ezineelwimi ezininzi, ezingalawulwa sisiNgesi, kuMzantsi weHlabathi uphela.

entry.title: Kyoto University framework offers universities a safer way to share student data with researchers

Kuqala inika abaphandi idata eyenziweyo ekhuselekileyo yokuphonononga, emva koko kufikelelo olulawulwayo kwidata yokwenyani kuphela xa kuvunyelwene nesikhundla esinedata ngemfuno ethile yophando. Le yilo yahlelwa kwaye yavavanywa kwimijikelo emininzi yomsebenzi kunye nabagcini bedata, abaphandi kunye nabafundi kwiiyunivesithi zaseJapan.

entry.title: UNESCO opens global consultation on governing AI so that education remains a common good
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO ivule uthethathethwano lwehlabathi jikelele, oluya kuqhubeka kude kube kwiNovemba 2026, imema abafundisi-ntsapho noongqondi bemigaqo-nkqubo ukuba baphawule kumaphepha asisiseko ngolawulo lwe-AI kwimfundo. Iphepha eliphambili, elikhululwe ngaphambi kweVeki yokuFunda kwedijithali ka-2026, licacisa iindlela ezintandathu iinjongo zemfundo zinganxulunyaniswa kabi uxa ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI kungalawulwa, kwaye ibonisa ukuba imfundo kufuneka ihlale ilungelo loluntu, kunokuba ulawulo lwayo lushiyelwe abanikezeli be-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Olu thethathethwano luya kubumba izikhokelo ze-UNESCO ezizayo ezijolise kuMasipala neeyunivesithi, nto leyo eyenza ibe sisicelo esibalulekileyo seNtsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, ngakumbi kumaziko akuMzantsi weHlabathi anamandla amancinci okuyila amaqhinga alawula i-AI abo.

entry.title: Universities in Korea, Singapore and the United Kingdom take different paths to redesign teaching for AI

category.term: Korea, Singapore and the United Kingdom

I-Korea Times ixela ukuba iiyunivesithi zaseKorea zongeze izithuba ezingaphezu kwe-4,000 kwiindawo ze-AI kunye nezifundo ezinxulumene nemizobo yombane ukusukela ngo-2024, kunye nokuba izicelo zokungena kwiiyunivesithi ezingamashumi amabini ezinkulu ze-AI zinyuke ngama-16% kulo nyaka, ngoxa urhulumente kufuneka anyanzele umda wezithuba ezintsha zobugcisa obuphezulu ku-434 ngo-2027 ngenxa yokunqongophala kwabasebenzi kunye nezixhobo. Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, lo mthelekiso ubonisa iimpendulo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo kuxinezelelo olufanayo, ukwakha amandla engeziweyo e-AI okanye ukuphinda uyile into kunye nendlela abafundi abavavanywa ngayo, ukhetho ekwaluphengulula ngaxesha linye iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi Afrika.

entry.title: Study proposes voice-based AI interviews as a richer alternative to end-of-semester course surveys
entry.summary:
Abaphandi abasuka kwiYunivesithi yobuGcisa yeMunich kunye ne-MIT Sloan School of Management bacebisa ukutshintsha uphononongo olubhaliweyo lokuphela kwesemestara ngodliwano-ndlebe olucwangcisiweyo olwenziwa ngumqondisi we-AI othethayo, onako ukubuza imibuzo elandelayo apho ifom ebhaliweyo ingenako. Uvavanyo lobugcisa kwiYunivesithi yobuGcisa yeMunich lubonise ukuba udliwano-ndlebe lwe-AI ngomnxeba luyenzeka, kwaye ababhali ngoku bacwangcisa uphononongo olupheleleyo lwentsimi kwikhosi ye-MIT Sloan enabafundi abalingana nama-60, baxoxa iimpendulo ngokucacileyo, ubutyebi bomxholo, umoya owakhayo kunye nokunzulu kwesimo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, lo phononongo ubonisa indlela esebenzayo yokusebenzisa i-AI yoncoko ngaphakathi kokufundisa: ukuguqula imvuselelo ebuthathaka kwaneempendulo ezimbalwa ibe yinto eneenkcukacha ezaneleyo ukuba ootitshala kunye namaziko benze isigqibo.

entry.title: Eduvos academic leader tells CNBC Africa that equal access to AI, not only AI literacy, will decide graduate employability
entry.summary:
Kwindibano yobukrelekrele bokwenziwa ye-CNBC Africa, inkokeli yezemfundo esuka kwiEduvos, iziko lemfundo ephakamileyo elizimele, ithe iiyunivesithi zoMzantsi Afrika azisenakho ukulinda ukuba zigqibe ukuba yintoni ebonakaliswa yi-AI kufundisa nabafundi, kwaye ulwazi lwe-AI, oko kukuthi ukwazi ukuba xa mele kuxhomekeke kwi-AI naxa mele ucinge ngokwakho, ngoku lubalulekile kangangokuba lulingana nolwazi lwemfundo esisiseko. Le nkokeli ilumkise ukuba ukufikelela kwi-AI akukho kufikelela kwisidanga kuphela: ngaphandle kwenkxaso yedijithali, iziseko kwaneeqhaga kubafundi abasuka kwiindawo ezinganezo zincomekileyo, i-AI inokukhulisa esikhundleni sokunciphisa ukungalingani phakathi kwabo baphumelele izidanga abangena entshukumweni yemisebenzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga nesakhono sabo baphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, udliwano-ndlebe lukhumbuza ukuba ukulungela i-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo yoMzantsi Afrika kuxhomekeke kakhulu kufikelelo olulinganayo kwizixhobo kunye neeziseko kanye njengoko kuxhomekeke kufundisa izakhono ze-AI.

entry.title: Seven-country study finds universities at very different stages of AI readiness
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olwenziwe kumazwe asixhenxe ngu-WISE kunye ne-Institute of International Education lufumanise ukuba iiyunivesithi zikwinqanaba elahlukileyo ngokubanzi kwindlela zokulungela i-AI eveliswayo, apho umgaqo-nkqubo, imvakalelo yabafundi kunye noluhlu lwezixhobo konke kungalinganiselani. Kwiyunivesithi enye yabucala eGhana, iipesenti ezingama-64 zootitshala zichaza ukuba zinomgaqo-nkqubo wecacileyo we-AI, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-27 kwiyunivesithi karhulumente yophando, nangona iipesenti ezingama-89 zootitshala kolu phononongo bebekade bayisebenzisa i-AI ngokwabo ngaphambili. Abaphandi balumkisa ukuba, ekubeni iimodeli eziphambili ze-AI ziqeqeshwa ikakhulu ngesiNgesi nazinye iilwimi eziphetheyo, amaziko ase-Afrika kunye namanye aseMzantsi weHlabathi asesichengeni sokuhlala esebenzisa i-AI kuphela, kungengoyakhi yona.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, olu phononongo lubonisa ukuba umsantsa wokulungela phakathi kwamaziko, kungekuphela phakathi kwamazwe, usenokwenza ukungalingani kukhule kunokuba kunciphe kwindlela imfundo ephakamileyo isamkela ngayo i-AI.

WISE and the Institute of International Education (IIE), reported by University World News · Established higher education press, reporting a WISE/IIE policy brief

entry.title: Dutch minister calls AI-written theses 'fraud', universities say detection scores cannot prove it
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olwenziwe ngumasa osasaza waseNetherlands kwiidisathesi ezingamakhulu zabafundi be-master kwiiyunivesithi ezilishumi elinazibini lufumanise ukuba kwidisathesi enye ethile kwiidisathesi ezintlanu, iibhothi zokuncokola ezifana ne-ChatGPT, i-Claude okanye i-Gemini zibhale isixa esingaphezulu sombhalo kunomfundi ngokwakhe. UMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uRianne Letschert, uthi oku bubuqhophololo, kodwa umbutho omele iiyunivesithi zaseNetherlands, iUniversiteiten van Nederland, uthi inqaku lokubonwa lodwa alinakungqina ukungaziphathi kakuhle, kwaye umbuzo wokwenyani ngendlela oviwo lwenziwa ngayo. IiYunivesithi zaseDelft, eUtrecht nase Leiden ngazimnye zithintele okanye zalele ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zokubona i-AI kumsebenzi wabafundi, zithi azithembakali.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI eveliswayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, impixano le ibonisa indlela ingxabano yobunyani bezemfundo enokutshintsha ngokukhawuleza ibe yeyopolitiko xa uMphathiswa engenelela, kwaye kungoko iqela lithethelela ukuphinda kuyilwe uvavanyo kunokuthembela kwisoftware yokubona.

entry.title: Russell Group students say they are taught little about AI, Bett UK survey finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwe-Bett UK kubafundi bomnyaka wokuqala abangaphezu kwe-1,000 e-UK lufumanise ukuba iipesenti ezingama-77 zabafundi kwiiyunivesithi ze-Russell Group zithi zifundiswa okuncinci okanye akukho nto ngokuphathelele i-AI, kuthelekiswa neepesenti ezingama-64 kwiiyunivesithi ze-post-1992. Olu phononongo lufumene kananjalo ukuba iipesenti ezingama-78 zabafundi bangawuxhasa esiqulathweni ngobuchwepheshe ngomfundi ngamnye nothatha ixesha elincinci, ngeli xesha kuphela iipesenti ezingama-34 eziva ukuba iyunivesithi yazo ibithembeke kubo malunga nokulindelekileyo ngokwenyani emva kokuphumelela. I-Russell Group ithe amalungu ayo aphinda ayile iinkqubo zokufunda kunye nemithetho yoviwo ngenxa yoku.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwiintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI eveliswayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufumaniseka kokuba iiyunivesithi ezigxile kuphando kakhulu zifundisa ubuchule be-AI kancinci kunamanye amaziko kuphakamisa umbuzo othe ngqo wolingano: ngubani kubo baphumelele izidanga abangena belungele kwimarike yemisebenzi eguqulwe yi-AI.

entry.title: New framework guides statistics and data science educators on teaching responsible generative AI use
entry.summary:
Iqela labafundisi-ntsapho be-statistics kunye ne-data science bapapashe uhlaka olunezahluko zine, ukuqonda, uphuhliso, ingxelo kunye nokhuseleko, ukukhokela indlela abafundisi-ntsapho abafundisa abafundi ngayo ukusebenzisa izixhobo ze-AI evelisayo ngoxanduva kwinkqubo yekhowudi kunye nohlalutyo lwe-statistics. Ilungiselelwe ngokusebenzisa iiworkshop kunye neembono zabafundi, kwaye sele isetyenziswe kwikhosi yakwi-intanethi evulekileyo enkulu kunye nokufundisa kwabafundi be-undergraduate kunye ne-postgraduate.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika 3, i-AI kunye nohlalutyo kwimfundo ye-STEM kunye nemfundo yootitshala, ifuna uhlaka olulungele igumbi lokufundela, ingekuko kuphela amazwi omgaqo-nkqubo; oku kunika iWits AHEAD umzekelo osebenzayo wokufundisa ulwazi lwe-AI evelisayo ngaphakathi kwesayensi enamanani.

entry.title: New tool scrambles assignment images so AI reading systems fail, but people can still read them
entry.summary:
Abaphandi bakhe i-AIRRI, isixhobo esitshintsha imifanekiso yemisebenzi eshicilelweyo ngokuguqula isithuba, ukubonakala kanye nengxolo yomfanekiso, kunye nokuhlaselwa okuphikisanayo, ukwenzela ukuba izixhobo ze-OCR kunye nee-chatbot ze-AI zisokole ukubhala kwakhona lo mbhalo, ngelixa umfundi oliqabane esakwazi ukufunda ngendlela eqhelekileyo. Xa yavavanywa kuxhomekeke kwiinkqubo zokufunda ezintathu, uhlaselo olunamandla kunene lwenza izinga leempazamo zoonobumba lenyuka ukusuka ku-2.3% ukuya ku-100%, kunye nezinga leempazamo zamagama enye inkqubo lenyuka ukusuka ku-24.9% ukuya ku-96.7%. Iqela laphinda lakhupha ulwazi lwemisebenzi yemfundo ephakamileyo ukuvavanya le ndlela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Intsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo: ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo, ifuna ukhuseleko olusebenza kwinqanaba lomsebenzi ngokwawo; iWits AHEAD ibukele izixhobo ezifana nesi ukubona ukuba ingqibelelo inokwakhiwa kwizixhobo zekhosi kunokuba ilandelwe emva kwexesha.

entry.title: New framework argues the cost of AI essay-marking systems should be measured against trustworthy scores, not efficiency alone
entry.summary:
Iphepha elitsha licebisa uhlaka “Loyilo Lokulinganisa Oluqwalasela Iindleko” lweenkqubo zokunika amanqaku kwiindaba ngesixhobo esizenzekelayo, lisithi iindleko zekhompyutha zokuphonononga nge-AI zihlala ziphathwa njengomba welungelelaniso lobuchwepheshe kuphela, lo gama ngokwenyani ingukhetho lokuyila ulinganiso. Uhlaka luchaza “iindleko ngenqaku elikhuselekileyo” elithelekisa iinkqubo zokunika amanqaku kuphela phakathi kweeyilo ezihlangabezana nomgangatho osezantsi wolinganiso oluthenjwayo, kuthi amandla olawulo kunye nokongamela kwaziko aphathwe njengomda kwiiyilo ezinokusetyenziswa, kungabi ziindleko ekufuneka zihlisiwe.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo, uhlaka lunika iiyunivesithi ezicinga ukusebenzisa ukunika amanqaku ngoncedo lwe-AI indlela eqinisekileyo yokubuza ukuba ingaba inkqubo etshiphu ivelisa ngokwenyani amanqaku athenjwayo, kunokugweba izixhobo zovavanyo olusenzekelayo ngesantya kunye neendleko kuphela.

entry.title: Study of a South African university finds online “participation profiles” mostly track how long a learner is observed, not how engaged they are
entry.summary:
Ngokuhlalutya iirekhodi zomfundi-ikhosi ezingama-16,448 ezivela kubafundi abangama-4,599 kwiikhosi ezili-152 kwiyunivesithi karhulumente yoMzantsi Afrika, abaphandi baphonononge amanqaku asibhozo ebe esetyenziselwa “ukuthatha inxaxheba” kwi-intanethi, baye bafumanisa ukuba onke abonisa kakhulu ixesha umfundi abukelweyo ekhosini kunokuthatha kwakhe inxaxheba ngokwenyani. Emva kokulungisa lo mphumo, iqela elincinci lamanqaku lisabahlulahlula abafundi ngendlela enkulu yeempawu ezimbini kunye nendlela eneenkcukacha yeempawu ezine, kodwa ngokuzithemba okungaphantsi kuphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele i-AI kunye noxhalutyo oluqikelelayo ngempumelelo yabafundi, le nto ifunyenweyo ngumyalezo othe ngqo kwiinkqubo zesilumkiso kwangethuba kunye nokugcina abafundi ezakhiweyo ngedatha yoMzantsi Afrika: ngaphandle kokuba ixesha umfundi alandelelwayo lithathelwa ingqalelo, inqaku elimphawula ngokuba “akathathi nxaxheba” linokuba ngumfundi nje obukelwe ixesha elimfutshane, hayi lowo usemngciphekweni ngokwenyani.
